MK: What was the impression stated by the participant calling the consult?
SBP: What was the specific question to the consultant?
Was the urgency of the consultation conveyed?
How will the consultant’s impression and recommendations be communicated to the team?
ICS: Did they identify themselves by name, team and role?
Did they provide the name, age and gender of the patient?
Did they provide relevant history and exam findings to the consultant?
Did they discuss pertinent results such as labs and radiographic studies?
Did they setting up the interview in some way? (e.g. find a private space, arrange for seats, silence pager/phone, ect.)
How did they assess the parent’s perceptions of what was happening before discussing the news?
Did they establish that they had difficult news to discuss and/or obtaining the parent’s invitation to discuss the news at this time?
Did they share knowledge using non-technical words and at a pace that was reasonable for the patient and their family?
How did they express empathy and identify emotions expressed by the recipient of the news?
Did they conclude with a strategy for next steps and a summary of what was discussed?
PROF: Was the communication between the participants courteous and professional?
